right_definition: OP argument: intensity 0-10 of the OP's own hedging or qualifying language (tentative, probabilistic or qualified claims) versus absolute declarative statements.

Assumption: the row score reflects the overall balance and prominence of hedging across the argument, weighted toward the central claims. Hedging density is not a frequency cutoff; no threshold is applied. If argument is missing or empty, return null.

left_definition: OP argument: 0-10 score of how strongly the OP's own claims use modest or uncertain epistemic markers (hedges, low-modality wording, explicit uncertainty).
left_spec: Read only the OP's argument text (current supplied text, including marked edits). Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible. Do not try to reconstruct an initial version. Evaluate only the OP's own assertions; exclude quoted external text or opponents' positions unless the OP adopts them. Score 0-10 for the degree to which the OP's own claims are expressed with modest/uncertain epistemic markers (e.g. may, might, perhaps, I think, to my knowledge, I'm not sure, seems). Aggregation assumption: judge the whole argument holistically, weighting central claims more. Missing or empty argument -> null. Output one number 0-10.

Return 0 if the text is assessable and contains no such explicit acknowledgment. right_definition: Other-user comments: share of comments in the list that directly quote the original post's (title or argument) wording; endorsement or refutation not required.
right_spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it) together with the OP's title and argument as context for what counts as OP wording. For each comment decide whether it contains a direct quotation of wording from the OP's title or argument (verbatim or near-verbatim text, typically in quotation marks or block-quote markup, that matches available OP text). Endorsement, refutation or agreement is not required. Paraphrases without quoted wording do not count; quoting other commenters or external sources does not count. Ignore and do not count quotations of OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates or any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even if in argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible text. Use current supplied text; do not infer timing. Output the number of comments with a qualifying quote divided by the total number of comments in the list (range 0 to 1; 0 if none quote). If OC_comments is an empty list return null; if OC_comments, title or argument is missing/malformed such that quote matching cannot be determined return null (a positive match with available OP text may still be returned as such only if the comment share can be computed).

right_definition: OP argument: contains an explicit narrative of the OP's own personal experience (events that happened to or were done by the OP), not merely hypotheticals, others' experiences or general opinion.

Return 1 if at least one comment presents a counterargument to the OP's stated view that is well-reasoned, i.e. gives a coherent, logically structured argument or supporting evidence rather than mere assertion, insult or off-topic remark. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if the OP view cannot be determined. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be retained. List order is not chronology or rank. Output a single 0/1 or null.
right_definition: Other-user comments: at least one comment contains specific numerical data or statistics offered as evidence (not mere general assertion).
right_spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment itself presents specific numerical data or statistics (e.g., concrete figures, percentages, rates, measured quantities, study results with numbers) used as evidence or support. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment does so, i.e., comments rely only on general assertions, reasoning, or non-evidential numbers (e.g., 'two reasons', list numbering). Illustrative examples are not exhaustive; external verification of accuracy is not required. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement. Empty valid list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null. Output a single 0/1 value.
